description: app_merge_write read as an account with write access, below admin, as app_merge_override_writer is, on a merge/5/base that a ruleset's "Restrict updates" rule covers, which the account can't bypass: every read of the repository's rulesets and of merge/5/base's rules holds it. GitHub fails each merge Lo sent into merge/5/base, of rozed-dev/e2e#174, #175 and #176, for that rule, where it said it merged, as it fails an async merge for a ruleset's rules: "Repository rule violations found", then "Cannot update this protected ref.". The reads each copy of Lo made after answer as before it sent the merge, since nothing merged. The copies after the first, which no derived test opens, read merge/5/base's commits as recorded, moved by the merges before them. These answers are derived: the recorders accept only rozed-bot's token, an admin's, and no account below admin merged anything.
